# Accepted vocabulary bundles

These bundles validate into immutable normalized logical vocabulary contracts.
The comprehensive case covers every v0 type/default form and reference-only
recursion. The reordered case proves JSON formatting and object/field order
change byte identity without changing logical vocabulary meaning.

Strict JSON forbids inline comments; licensing for the exact `.json` bytes is
recorded here under Apache-2.0.
